test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I was fascinated by the novel.

options.text: The novel was fascinated to me.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The novel fascinated me'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'I'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the novel'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'was fascinated' will be changed into fascinated'. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *The novel fascinated me.*
